name: Fractales
tagline: Multilingual WebAssembly fractal explorer — 83 fractals, static GitHub Pages, FAIR open knowledge
description: An interactive fractal explorer compiled from French-syntax source (multilingual programming language) to WebAssembly. The application renders 83 mathematical fractals across 10 families in the browser with no backend server. It exposes a static JSON API for machine discovery and a URL-based deep-link system for shareable views. This manifest enables AI agents and autonomous tools to discover, query, and navigate the application programmatically.

findable.description: All data is indexed at /api/families.json and /api/fractals.json

accessible.description: All resources served over HTTPS as static files, no authentication required

interoperable.description: Tools defined in MCP and OpenAI function-calling formats; schemas in JSON Schema draft 2020-12

reusable.description: Source code in .multi (multilingual) and .py (Python transpiled) available at static URLs; fractal mathematics fully documented in API entries

parameters.ps: Pixel size — units per pixel, controls zoom (required)
parameters.jr: Julia parameter c real part for Julia-family fractals (optional)
parameters.ji: Julia parameter c imaginary part for Julia-family fractals (optional)
parameters.pc: Palette contour enhancement flag, 1 when enabled (optional)
parameters.lc: L-system line coloring mode: uniforme, progression, profondeur, orientation (optional)
parameters.lsw: Applied L-system proposal stroke width from 0.5 to 6 (optional)
parameters.azi: Mode Abysses automatic iteration flag, 1 when enabled (optional)
parameters.q: Mode Abysses quality level: standard, fine, extreme (optional)
parameters.fog: Studio 3D depth fog amount from 0 to 1 (optional)
parameters.ov: Comma-separated mathematical weather overlays: grille, contours, orbite (optional)
parameters.lp: Applied Atelier L-system proposal flag, 1 when enabled (optional)
parameters.la: Applied L-system proposal angle in degrees (optional)
parameters.lr: Applied L-system proposal rewrite rules, including optional weighted stochastic alternatives (optional)
parameters.fpa: Applied Atelier formula proposal flag, 1 when enabled (optional)
parameters.ffm: Applied formula mode: mandelbrot or julia (optional)

source_access.description: Each fractal is implemented in the multilingual programming language and transpiled to Python. Source files are served as static assets.

agent_guidance.recommended_workflow: 1. Fetch /api/families.json to understand available categories. 2. Fetch /api/families/{id}.json or /api/fractals.json to find a specific fractal. 3. Call construct_deeplink to generate a viewer URL. 4. Optionally fetch the source code at the module URL.
agent_guidance.no_server: All operations are client-side. Tools that fetch data use GET requests to static JSON files. construct_deeplink requires no HTTP request at all.
agent_guidance.deep_links_are_shareable: Deep links encode the complete view state in the URL fragment. They open in any browser, load the correct fractal, and animate to the encoded position.
agent_guidance.mcp_integration: Register the tools from tools.json in any MCP-compatible client. The tools have no side effects and require no authentication.
